sources.title: slm125m — a 125M legal & financial language model, trained from scratch
sources.snippet: A 125.8M-parameter legal & financial language model, built from scratch for $31.76 and RAFT fine-tuned to refuse when the answer isn't in the context.

sources.title: GitHub - shivamfet/slm125m · GitHub
sources.snippet: A 125M-parameter Llama-style language model trained from scratch on legal and financial text, then fine-tuned twice — once for grounded question answering, once for closed-book. This repo holds the whole pipeline: data collection, cleaning, tokenizer training, pretraining, SFT, evaluation, and the review tooling used to inspect every dataset before training on it.
